content.json:
# Visitor Analytics Dashboard

Real-time metrics for zach.olinski.com traffic and user engagement.

parameters.name: Time Range
parameters.description: Set the time range for the data

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend uid = tostring(column_ifexists('user_Id', ''))
| summarize UniqueUsers = dcountif(uid, isnotempty(uid)), TotalRequests = count()
| project UniqueUsers, TotalRequests
content.title: Unique Visitors (7d)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| summarize TotalPageViews = countif(url has '/posts/' or url has '/published/' or (url !has '/api/' and isnotempty(url)))
| project TotalPageViews
content.title: Total Page Views (7d)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend op = tostring(column_ifexists('operation_Id', ''))
| summarize Sessions = dcountif(op, isnotempty(op))
| project Sessions = coalesce(Sessions, 0)
content.title: Sessions (7d)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| summarize AvgDurationMs = avg(duration)
| project AvgDuration = round(coalesce(AvgDurationMs, 0.0), 2)
content.title: Avg Request Duration (ms)

content.query:
let data = requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(url) and url !has '/api/'
| extend Page = coalesce(tostring(parse_url(url).Path), name)
| summarize Views = count() by Page;
data
| union (datatable(Page:string, Views:long) [ 'No data yet', 0 ])
| summarize Views = sum(Views) by Page
| order by Views desc
content.title: Top Pages

content.query:
let data = requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend browser = tostring(column_ifexists('client_Browser', ''))
| summarize Views = count() by Browser = iff(isempty(browser), 'Unknown', browser);
data
| union (datatable(Browser:string, Views:long) [ 'No data yet', 0 ])
| summarize Views = sum(Views) by Browser
| order by Views desc
content.title: Traffic by Browser

content.query:
let data = requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| extend region = tostring(column_ifexists('client_CountryOrRegion', ''))
| summarize Views = count() by Region = iff(isempty(region), 'Unknown', region);
data
| union (datatable(Region:string, Views:long) [ 'No data yet', 0 ])
| summarize Views = sum(Views) by Region
| order by Views desc
content.title: Traffic by Region

content.query:
let data = requests
| where timestamp > ago(7d)
| where isnotempty(name)
| summarize AvgDurationMs = avg(duration), Failures = countif(success == false), Total = count() by name
| extend FailureRate = iff(Total == 0, 0.0, (todouble(Failures) / todouble(Total)) * 100.0)
| project Endpoint = name, ['Avg Duration (ms)'] = round(coalesce(AvgDurationMs, 0.0), 2), ['Failure Rate (%)'] = round(FailureRate, 2);
data
| union (datatable(Endpoint:string, ['Avg Duration (ms)']:real, ['Failure Rate (%)']:real) [ 'No data yet', 0.0, 0.0 ])
| order by ['Avg Duration (ms)'] desc
content.title: API Performance
